methodology_notes.architecture: All 38 items confirmed as single-object format (no dual-block). QuestionID, content fields (Part, Section, Topic, Stem, Choices, CorrectChoice, ExplanationCorrect, StudyLinks), and metadata fields (question_state, VerifiedChecks, ExplanationWrongA-D, DifficultyScore, CognitiveLevel) are all within a single JSON object per QID.

risk_factors_defined.topic_sensitivity_1: Simple definition-recognition (e.g., 'What is the fraud triangle?', 'What is physical access control?') = TS 1
risk_factors_defined.topic_sensitivity_3: Requires nuanced distinction between related concepts (e.g., inherent vs control risk, ERM risk appetite vs risk tolerance, ITGC vs application control) = TS 3-4
risk_factors_defined.ew_readiness_1: All 3 distractor EW slots have genuine, choice-specific text >= 50 chars. CC slot correctly empty. = EW 1
risk_factors_defined.ew_readiness_5: Only 0-1 of 4 slots have any text; >2 non-CC slots empty = EW 5 (certification-blocking)
risk_factors_defined.blueprint_complexity_1: Tests single COSO concept with no cross-domain dependencies = BC 1
risk_factors_defined.content_structure_1: Single-object architecture, no dual-block, no CC-position ambiguity = CS 1
